designer-initial.summary: Selected an appendix-faithful medium Isolette architecture with eight independent regulator/monitor owners, 20 typed interactions, closed priority/recovery policies, and explicit source/formalization/claim boundaries.
questions_for_model: Can current SysML-AADL/GUMBO forms express owner-local prior-state retention for Heat Control and Alarm Control plus latched regulator/monitor modes without central recomputation or support usages?
Can Display Temperature remain type-bounded but unconstrained outside regulator NORMAL while any required initialization value is marked generated support?
Can the 0.5-, 1.0-, 5-, and 6-second source values be retained as traceable properties while finite supervision classifications drive logical contracts without implying physical timing proof?
If integer-tenths record fields are not checker-realizable, what smallest finite type representation preserves rounding, 0.5-degree alarm bands, and all boundary partitions?

model-review.summary: Retain all eight substantive owners and domain behavior, but add one nonsemantic Process container because current checker containment rules cannot host owner-local stateful GUMBO at depth 1.

findings.evidence: Current checker probes accept state/initialize/compute and In(state) on Thread and accept System -> Process -> Thread with Well-formed!, but reject Thread directly under System, reject GUMBO on a nested Abstract owner, and reject stateful or integration clauses on a nested System owner. The selected root-System/direct-owner depth-1 allocation therefore cannot satisfy owner-local state and containment simultaneously.
findings.requested_change: Keep PART-01..PART-08 as the eight semantic owners but realize them as Threads inside one behavior-free generated-support Process under the single root System; change containment depth from 1 to 2; permit ten uncredited boundary-delegation connections so 30 resolved connections realize the unchanged 20 semantic INT-01..INT-20 flows. Keep semantic metrics 8/20/20/8 and all domain behavior unchanged.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit finds meaningful local derivations for all eight owners: PART-01 and PART-05 perform many-to-one validity classification (PART-01 also rounds tenths to whole degrees); PART-02 and PART-06 derive resettable latches from prior state and events; PART-03 and PART-07 combine health causes with prior mode/reset/deadline; PART-04 and PART-08 apply threshold, priority, and retention policies. Copies, bundles, timeout carriage, and one-to-one mode/status renames are explicitly uncredited.

The current checker returns Well-formed! for attribute-based Data records with integer and enum-valued fields, bounded invariants, integer tenths arithmetic and division, typed 500 ms/1 s/5 s/6 s properties, generated initialization guarantees, NORMAL-only output implications, and In(state) retention.
findings.requested_change: Use attribute fields typed by AADL Data wrappers, integer tenths and +/-5 alarm-band arithmetic, owner-local Thread state, and traceable time properties; mark Display Temperature initialization and the Process/Thread hosting categories as generated tool support rather than source behavior or execution evidence.

findings.evidence: The 20 planned semantic interactions preserve two independent regulator/monitor regions; no Desired settings enter the monitor, no Alarm settings enter the regulator, and root/analyzer checks are forbidden from recomputing owner-local policy. Physical timing, plant, probability, diagnostic, execution, proof, and certification claims remain deferred.

designer-resolution.summary: Accepted the checker-required Process containment revision while preserving all eight owners, 20 semantic interactions, contracts, scenarios, independence, and deferred claims.

model-generation.summary: Localized the repair to the canonical Current and Display Temperature bounds, one shared root Current Temperature fan-out, source-backed bounded evidence, campaign-v1 ownership wire records, and SRC-REQ-TH-04/05 monitor-region trace coverage; architecture and final SysML typechecks and the bounded analyzer all passed.

visualization.summary: Accepted one validated system-overview with repaired single-sample fan-out, 20 representative routed edges, zero crossings/collisions, passed native review, and complete relevant traceability.

designer-final.summary: Accepted: source, bounded owner-local semantics, traceability, and visualization pass; executable evidence is not required for the specification-only profile.

reason: Accepted: source, bounded owner-local semantics, traceability, and visualization pass; executable evidence is not required for the specification-only profile.
claim_boundary: Acceptance is limited to retained source/tool, bounded finite-analysis, trace, rendered-review, and Designer evidence. Deferred claims remain deferred.
